newsitem.title: USA: Iowa House advances $22 mln property tax relief.
newsitem.headline: Iowa House advances $22 mln property tax relief.

text.p: The Iowa House has advanced a $22 million property tax relief package to Gov. Terry Branstad on a 98-0 vote, an aide to the House speaker said Tuesday.

The fully-funded property tax credits passed by representatives on Monday provide an indirect cut that Branstad is expected to sign, said Jeff Mitchell, an aide to House Speaker Ron Corbett, R-Cedar Rapids.
Iowa legislators expect to wrap up this year's session by the end of the week when expense payments run out.
